mustPlays.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
mustPlays.why: Leads NFL in touches & TDs, ~30 DK pts/gm, top projection on the slate in the 54.5-total game. Every source has him #1.

mustPlays.name: Jacoby Brissett
mustPlays.why: $5,500 for a QB facing the defense allowing the most DK pts to QBs (28.9/gm). Cash lock per FantasyLabs, FantasyPros, Footballguys; FTN's top GPP QB by ROI.

mustPlays.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
mustPlays.why: Top point-per-dollar WR (RotoWire), FTN's #1 WR by ROI; Arizona ranks last in yards per attempt.

mustPlays.name: Trey McBride
mustPlays.why: 7+ catches every game; Detroit allows the most DK pts to TEs (28.4). Stacks with Brissett.

core.name: Michael Wilson
core.why: 93.9% route rate, 30 targets in 2 games; DET allows 2nd-most DK pts to WRs.

core.name: Braelon Allen
core.why: Breece Hall out; played 94% of snaps last week. Best RB under $6K (rain risk).

core.name: Jaylen Warren
core.why: Rico Dowdle unlikely to play (Schefter, Sun AM) - Warren gets the backfield; Stokastic's best pts/$ RB above $6K.

core.name: D'Andre Swift
core.why: Monangai out; GB allows 2nd-most DK pts to RBs.

core.name: Sam LaPorta
core.why: ARI allows 3rd-most to TEs; ~1/3 of McBride's ownership (leverage).

core.name: Jared Goff
core.why: GPP pivot from Brissett: same shootout, ARI allowed 11 pass TDs.

stacks: Brissett + McBride + M. Wilson w/ Gibbs/St. Brown bring-back
Goff + St. Brown + LaPorta w/ McBride bring-back
Bears/Packers pivot: Love + Watson/Kraft w/ Swift

fades.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
fades.why: $8,800 in a tough SF matchup; St. Brown projects similar for $900 less (RotoWire)

fades.name: Garrett Wilson
fades.why: Overowned vs optimal in a 39.5 total (Stokastic)

fades.name: Ashton Jeanty
fades.why: GTD foot/ankle, DNP Friday - pivot to Mike Washington Jr. if out

default.notes: Sunday AM update: McConkey out (Tre' Harris up), Dowdle unlikely (Warren up), Stevenson/Kamara/K. Allen playing, Jefferson/Addison/McLaurin/Jeanty are game-time decisions - check 11:30am ET inactives. Lions-Cardinals (54.5) is still the core game.

sleepers.name: Jameson Williams
sleepers.why: ~6% owned in the 54.5-total game; 91% route rate and team-high 5 targets of 20+ yards vs the defense allowing the most yards per pass (FantasyLabs, DK Network). One deep TD away from 25+.

sleepers.name: Quinshon Judkins
sleepers.why: ~5% owned; Jets allow the 4th-most rushing yards to RBs and gave up 400+ yards and 5 TDs to backs the last two games (FantasyLabs, DK Network).

sleepers.name: Rome Odunze
sleepers.why: Targets up every week (3→7), 89% snaps, 20.6% target share; GB allows 31.9 DK pts/gm to WRs (FantasyPros, DK Network).

sleepers.name: Courtland Sutton
sleepers.why: $4,600 - cheapest since 2021; 7 red-zone targets and no TD yet; Payton taking over play-calling vs a LAC defense allowing 7.4 YPA (FantasyLabs).

sleepers.name: Tre' Harris
sleepers.why: $4,100 and now the Chargers' WR1 with McConkey, Johnston and Thompson all out (Schefter, Footballguys).

sleepers.name: Roman Wilson
sleepers.why: $3,700 punt with Pittman out; top punt candidate (Footballguys); in the max-points lineup.

sleepers.name: Antonio Williams
sleepers.why: $3,800 rookie: 12 catches on 19 targets; Diggs out and McLaurin a game-time decision (DK Network Millionaire picks).

sleepers.name: Bears
sleepers.why: $2,900; ~10 DK pts/gm last 3, 3rd-best sack rate (8.6%); Packers without Josh Jacobs (DK Network).
